title: Legal Rule Induction: Towards Generalizable Principle Discovery from Analogous Judicial Precedents
abstract: arXiv:2505.14104v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Legal rules encompass not only codified statutes but also implicit adjudicatory principles derived from precedents that contain discretionary norms, social morality, and policy. While computational legal research has advanced in applying established rules to cases, inducing legal rules from judicial decisions remains understudied across jurisdictions. The advent of Large Language Models (LLMs) offers unprecedented potential to automate the extraction of such latent principles, yet progress is stymied by the absence of formal task definitions and benchmarks. To address this gap, we formalize Legal Rule Induction (LRI) as the task of deriving concise, generalizable doctrinal rules from analogous precedents, distilling their shared preconditions, normative behaviors, and legal consequences. translated_title: 法律规则归纳：从类似司法先例中发现可泛化的原则
translated_abstract: arXiv:2505.14104v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：法律规则不仅包括成文法规，还包括源自先例的隐含裁判原则，这些原则包含裁量性规范、社会道德和政策。虽然计算法律研究在将既定规则应用于案件方面取得了进展，但从司法判决中归纳法律规则在不同司法管辖区仍研究不足。大语言模型（LLMs）的出现为自动化提取此类潜在原则提供了前所未有的潜力，但缺乏正式的任务定义和基准阻碍了进展。为解决这一差距，我们将法律规则归纳（LRI）形式化为从类似先例中推导简洁、可泛化的教义规则的任务，提炼其共享的前提条件、规范行为和法律后果。我们进一步提出了一种可复现的LRI数据集构建流程，并将其应用于中国法律作为代表性司法管辖区进行实例化。
tldr: 本文首次形式化定义了法律规则归纳（LRI）任务，并提出了一种可复现的数据集构建流程，利用大语言模型从类似司法先例中自动提取可泛化的法律原则。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes the Legal Rule Induction (LRI) task for the first time and proposes a reproducible dataset construction pipeline, leveraging large language models to automatically extract generalizable legal principles from analogous judicial precedents.
